description: Proposed single storey rear and side extension to the existing dwelling, extending up to 3.0m at the rear, with associated internal reconfiguration. The development includes formation of an enlarged utility kitchen, additional ground floor room with ensuite, and improved circulation space, incorporating rooflights to enhance natural daylight. Works also involve alterations to openings, installation of new windows/doors (including obscured glazing where required), and all associated structural and drainage modifications in accordance.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [DEW/2026/04/33DN/S1(02), DEW/2026/04/33DN/S2(02), DEW/2026/04/33DN/01(02), DEW/2026/04/33DN/02(02), DEW/2026/04/33DN/03(02), DEW/2026/04/33DN/04(02), DEW/2026/04/33DN/05(02), DEW/2026/04/33DN/06(02), DEW/2026/04/33DN/07(02), DEW/2026/04/33DN/08(02), DEW/2026/04/33DN/09(02), DEW/2026/04/33DN/10(02),  Planning statement, Design and Access Statement, Daylight Sunlight and Overshadowing Assessment, Local Biodiversity checklist, Flood Risk Assessment, Fire safety statement- Received 16/04/2026].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or openings shall be formed in the front or side elevations of the development hereby permitted.
Reason: In the interests of the character and appearance of the area
